subject: aftd
title: AF.TD.------MT.INFO.
description: First of two diagrams in ALT(FT)II-7. The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'creative music have already established a significant momentum — with respect to how its affinity dynamics have determined the present course western culture is now pursuing — and as such, this continuum is in an excellent position to accelerate the fundamentals of the next time cycle.' The crossing diagrams how affinity-tendencies structurally meets meta-information: AFTD (affinity tendencies) crossed with MT-INFO (meta-information). AFTD sits centrally with the subject-arrow; PRI-INFO (principle information) at upper-center and ATTN (attention) with VT-PLT (vibrational plateau) at upper-right as the partner-side upper outputs. (P)UTZ (physical-universe utilization) sits at upper-left. T-L (time-line) sits centrally and (R)P-FC (the reality of political focus/functionalism) at center-right as the bridging hubs. SPT-D (spectacle dictates) at the left-center and (R)INTR (the reality of introduction) below as the subject's downward chain. PER-DY (perceived dynamics) and MT-INFO at right-bottom anchor the partner-axis terminus. Structural argument: when affinity-tendencies is crossed with meta-information, the upper diagonal (P)UTZ → PRI-INFO → ATTN → VT-PLT is the *physical-universe-utilization route* — physical-universe-utilization routes through principle-information into attention, finally producing vibrational-plateau on the partner-side. AFTD → T-L is the bridging-axis route: affinity-tendencies routes through time-line into the bridging hub. SPT-D → (R)INTR is the subject's downward chain — spectacle-dictates routes through the reality of introduction. (R)P-FC → PER-DY → MT-INFO is the partner-axis's downward chain: the reality of political-focus routes through perceived-dynamics into meta-information. The structural argument: the acceleration the prose names structurally requires holding the (P)UTZ upper diagonal *and* the AFTD → T-L bridging diagonal both open — affinity-tendencies determine the present-course only when the upper-physical-utilization chain runs to vibrational-plateau without absorbing the bridging-axis's time-line edge.
